texts: Stored mire-essence stays good for years.
The village potter makes the clay vessels.
The clay comes from a seam in the cliffs.
The clay has a green tint.

fields.sentence: Stored mire-essence stays good for years.
parse: (: me1_rule (Implication (And (Member $x mire_essence) (Member $x stored)) (And (Member (sk_good $x) good) (Experiencer (sk_good $x) $x) (Still (sk_good $x)) (Member $x good) (MeasureAtLeast (sk_good $x) duration 2 year))) (STV 0.9 0.9))

q2_gaps: a generic copular claim whose bare kind subject carries an attributive restriction ("stored mire-essence") — restricted kind subjects are routed to a distributing rule only for kind relations, and ConditionalProperty is licensed only for when/at/under/if conditions and locative/domain PPs, so this routing is unsettled
review.notes: The continuation-copular shape (reified state + Still + flat half, no tense) and the bare-plural duration MeasureAtLeast 2 year both follow the instruction set, with the flat half carried inside the rule conclusion as (Member $x good). Compound genus and the participle-as-adjective 'stored' are handled per Names and casing.

fields.sentence: The village potter makes the clay vessels.

review.notes: Both compounds follow the part-of-speech line exactly: `village_potter` and `clay_vessel` get their head genus while the noun modifiers `village` and `clay` are correctly left unexposed, and `potter` correctly gets no agent-nominalization capability ("a potter is one who pots" fails the by-definition test). Definite plural object -> group witness, creation verb -> `Patient`, and simple present -> no status atom (unmarked habitual) are all right.

fields.sentence: The clay comes from a seam in the cliffs.

review.notes: Theme on the clay follows the un-powered-relocation rule for intransitive subjects, 'in the cliffs' correctly attaches to the seam as entity-side LocatedIn (containment), and the definite plural 'the cliffs' correctly takes a GroupOf witness rather than Inheritance. Attaching the PP to the seam rather than to the coming event is a world-knowledge lean, not a tie, so the single reading is right.

fields.sentence: The clay has a green tint.

review.notes: Verbal 'have' reified with Holder subject and Theme object, the definite mass NP as a typed witness, and 'green tint' left unfused as two atoms on the tint witness all follow the instruction set. The bare simple present correctly takes no status atom, and no Possession atom is emitted (seeded rules derive it).
